GoFish prototype · enclose outline

Enclose Outline Playground

Move the sliders to redraw the unified enclose outline live. It is the prototype's own code: links join the members, an exact closing by a disc of radius r fills the gaps (convexity picks r), keep-outs are cut out, and a Gaussian smoothing rounds the result. Above convexity 1 the hull blends toward the oval.

Shape

On: one piece, joined by spanning-tree links (Shape.blob). Off: the arcs preset, pieces stay apart where the disc passes between them (Shape.arcs).
0 spine1 hull2 oval
Up to 1: the share of the area between the padded members and their padded hull that is filled (it picks the closing radius). 1 to 2: the hull blended toward the smallest enclosing ellipse.
The width of each link as a share of the padded members it joins: 1 is no neck.
The closing disc's radius. Two pieces join where the disc cannot pass between them.
Keep a gap the outline closes around as a hole.
enclose's own option. Each dataset loads its story's padding.
